summary: AMASS Brands filed an 8-K regarding a Side Letter Agreement with Full Glass Wine Co., LLC and Full Glass Licensing, LLC that terminates a Multi-Year Wine Purchase Agreement. Full Glass's $4,000,000 purchase obligation (about 111,333 cases) is replaced by a $427,000 settlement. A $31,750 balance is due July 31, 2026; the remaining $406,000 is a deposit applied either to future wine purchases plus equity redemption of AMASS's FGWC units at $8.77 per unit, or solely to equity redemption. Late payments trigger a $10,000 charge with 7-day cure; failure voids the agreement and reinstates original obligations. Also, Full Glass paid its secured promissory note, prompting release of security interests. Watch for Full Glass election and potential sale trigger payments.
